expected.raw_text: Practical experience with containers and Kubernetes

parsed.notes:
“What we are looking for” sets required skills; “Helpful experience” is interpreted as an optional-experience heading.
ML infrastructure is mapped to AI Infrastructure as the same infrastructure skill expressed for ML.
Company/product descriptions and responsibilities are not treated as a dedicated technology stack or independent candidate requirements.
Alternative groups also contain unmapped examples in the source: KV caching in group 3, multi-GPU jobs in group 4, and TGI in group 5. The requested unmapped schema has no grouping field.
Reinforcement learning has no alternative_group because the other alternatives in its list have no taxonomy entries; a group needs at least two mapped skills.
Private connectivity maps to the already-required networking skill, and identity federation maps to the already-required access-control skill.
Robotics is read literally as domain knowledge and excluded. Customer-facing communication, consulting, ownership, and working with incomplete requirements are not technical skills here.
Solutions architecture, distributed computing, and infrastructure automation are left unmapped rather than equated with software architecture, distributed systems, or infrastructure as code.
